name: Densha de Chikan Enzai no Fukushuu no Hate ni, Otoko wa Miserare, Onna wa Ochiru
original_name: 電車で痴漢冤罪の復讐の果てに、男は魅せられ、女は堕ちる
source:
Wataru Kodera was fired from his job after a complaint of misconduct.
He'd been falsely accused of groping by a coworker. Her name was Akane Nakazono.

Wondering how he might get back at her,
Wataru happened to see Akane on the train, and rage erupted from his core.
He relished doing his first criminal deed to a woman who claimed
he'd already done it. But was this poetic retribution of a good man with nothing to lose,
or an excuse to unleash the wickedness that he was harboring all along?

In either case, Wataru would have revenge.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162899.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小寺涉因不当行为投诉而被解雇。
他被同事错误地指控猥亵。她的名字叫中园茜。

想知道他会如何报复她，
渡在电车上偶然看到茜，心中怒火爆发。
他很享受对一名女子犯下的第一起犯罪行为，这名女子声称
他已经做到了。但这是一个没有什么可失去的好人的诗意报应吗？
还是一个释放他一直以来所怀有的邪恶的借口？

不管怎样，涉都会报仇。
